exports: internal fun\const owning-field source set, integrated by core namespace preparation
availability: single current core; direct names, no client import or version choice
named_expression: ordinary :: expression operation with its invariant signature-declaration contract; ALL arguments are DATA, including NAME. One whole right Structure is one external actual. The common namespace/field-consumption mechanism reads its immediate declaration fields, or those of its referenced DATA target, when the receiver contract requires a list.

composed_expression.signature: two int inputs, int result; no body or automatic currying
composed_expression.consumption: The tree grouper resolves priorities, groups and explicit streams; the distinct application adapter maps its current-level results to the receiving ABI. :: consumes its prepared positional profile exclusively as DATA, without local RHS evaluation or service-field reflection. Common namespace reading supplies immediate declaration fields when that DATA contract requires a list; it is not a second operand-opening pass.

explicit_value_path.contract: existing ordinary value declaration followed by the ready-reference named declaration

receiver_meaning_checks.expected: Declares a named signature in CODE or DATA context and consumes ALL arguments exclusively as DATA, including NAME. For a declaration-list contract, common namespace consumption reads the immediate fields of the supplied Structure or referenced DATA. The external actual vector, nested models and return descriptions remain intact; no Structure call, formal-initializer execution or recursive flattening follows.
const keeps its modifier contract and always consumes DATA arguments
private keeps its binding modifier contract and always consumes DATA arguments

builtin_mode_metadata: Implementation and mode metadata are not supplied; no PASS_ARGS_AS_IS value is inferred for builtin ::
anonymous_structure_contract: An anonymous Structure is not called as a callable or new activation; it may execute in place in CODE/Expression under the ordinary rules. Inspecting signature DATA does not execute that Structure.
description_opening: The common namespace/field-sequence mechanism reads ordered immediate fields of a supplied Structure or referenced DATA when the receiving contract requires a declaration or field list. :: uses this mechanism under its DATA-only signature contract. DATA or CODE determines element consumption; the receiving contract chooses a list or a whole value. Whole TYPE/model/value contracts preserve their object. A ready positional profile remains a profile; its service fields are not declarations. This changes neither external actuals nor operand preparation and does not extend CODE W/E to DATA.

expression_architecture.grouper: Resolve priorities, groups and explicit field streams in the supplied pure graph, including references consumed as CODE/Expression. Notation, source origin and parenthesis history are not semantic flags. Produce a structured current-level operation/stream plan without rewriting or reparsing text.
expression_architecture.application_adapter: Package the left side as one actual and the current-level right stream as an Array of references under the receiving ABI. This packaging belongs to the application adapter, not the grouper.
expression_architecture.collector: RxLogicalArguments and library asOperand forward the projected actual vector; no element traversal, reverse packing or additional opening pass.
expression_architecture.roles: VALUE/TYPE/DATA and whole-value contracts do not become CODE automatically. In CODE/Expression, an ordinary named Structure with the current lexical parent follows the ordinary call path; a named Structure with a different parent and every anonymous Structure are handled as graph groups, retaining their real parent. Name/actual-parent relative to traversal owner determines the branch, not reference provenance. Planning does not run DATA or force RAW.
expression_architecture.raw_occurrence: Retain each complete nested Expression as one original RAW occurrence with its live context; do not pass its physical tokens as several actuals or evaluate it during planning.
expression_architecture.graph_references: Consume the supplied pure graph under its receiving role. In CODE/Expression: named + current lexical parent means ordinary call; named + other parent means group; anonymous means group. Preserve actual parent and binding context; do not use source-origin or parenthesis flags.

group_copy_equivalence.reason: copy is an explicit field stream; the current-level group assignment consumes that stream without an otherwise unnecessary outer RHS group. Values are ready before any destination write.
group_copy_equivalence.whole_value_control: scalar := (copy(d)) retains its Structure when scalar receives one whole value

parent_cases.expected: Treat S as the same group shape as direct (a b c d), preserving its actual parent and context; this branch creates no call activation.
Use the ordinary named-Structure call path and its admission; do not silently inline it as a foreign-parent group.

parent_cases.actual_parent: current lexical parent or another parent
parent_cases.expected: An anonymous Structure remains a group; execution, when required by CODE/Expression, is in place rather than a named call.

code_graph_reference_control.numeric_result: Not asserted: four neighboring atoms do not automatically form a numeric expression; + admission and any ordinary call result are checked separately.
code_graph_reference_control.value_boundary: A Structure admitted in a VALUE/TYPE/DATA position remains under that contract, regardless of its name or parent; the CODE classification is not applied automatically there.
code_graph_reference_control.provenance: Source spelling/origin and P0 diagnostic provenance do not decide the branch.
